project.name: AI Search Workspace Answer Detail
project.summary: An app-page workflow for an AI search product where a user asks a question, reviews a sourced answer, inspects citations, and saves or shares the result.

diagnosis.raw_request: 帮我做一个 AI 搜索产品的研究工作台页面
main_gaps: The request does not define answer states.
The request does not define source citation behavior.
The request does not define the source detail panel or mobile ordering.
The request does not define save/share behavior.
risk: A generator may create a generic dashboard without answer trust hierarchy.
A generator may hide source citations or omit failed and low-confidence states.

audience.primary_user: knowledge workers and analysts who need to verify AI search answers before using them
audience.secondary_user: team leads reviewing saved research artifacts from teammates
audience.context_of_use: The user is inside the product, comparing an AI answer with source documents under time pressure.
pain_points: AI answers are hard to trust when sources are buried.
Users need to inspect source details without losing the answer context.
Failed, partial, or low-confidence answers need clear recovery paths.
jobs_to_be_done: Ask a work question and understand the answer state.
Verify which sources support the answer.
Open source details, recover from unavailable sources, and save or share useful answers.

goals.business_goal: increase trust and repeat use of sourced AI answers
goals.design_goal: make the query, answer confidence, answer body, and source origin clear in the first screen
goals.conversion_goal: move users from one-off search to saved and shared research workflows

message.core_claim: Review every AI answer with visible sources, confidence, and recovery paths.
supporting_points: Keep the query, answer status, and confidence visible.
Show source titles, excerpts, link status, date, and owner or system.
Let users inspect source detail without losing the answer context.
Handle empty, loading, partial, low-confidence, failed, and source-unavailable states.
proof_points: Answer panel with confidence and citation markers.
Source list with excerpts and status labels.
Source detail panel with selected source metadata.
Save/share controls with success and failed states.
content_warnings: Do not invent customer data, proprietary source names, or unsupported accuracy claims.
Avoid vague AI assistant copy that does not explain source trust.

screens: tablet answer detail with collapsible source detail
flows: user enters a query and submits search
answer generates with visible loading state
user reviews confidence and cited source markers
user selects a source and opens source detail
user saves or shares the answer
user retries when answer generation or source loading fails

section_details.purpose: Keep the user's query visible and editable.
section_details.visual_anchor: Full-width search bar with compact metadata

section_details.purpose: Answer what the user asked, how trustworthy it is, and where it comes from.
section_details.visual_anchor: Compact status row above the answer

section_details.purpose: Present the sourced answer in a readable structure.
Make source origin discoverable and scannable.
section_details.visual_anchor: Stacked source cards with active and unavailable states

section_details.purpose: Show selected source details without hiding the answer.
section_details.visual_anchor: Right panel on desktop and expandable panel on tablet/mobile

section_details.purpose: Turn useful answers into team artifacts.
section_details.visual_anchor: Compact action row tied to answer state

interaction_states: Search input states: empty, input, submitting, failed, retry.
Answer area states: empty, generating, success, partial, low-confidence, failed.
Source list states: empty, loading, available, source-unavailable.
Source detail states: unselected, loading, success, permission-blocked.
Save/share states: idle, working, success, failed.
interaction_contract: Submitting a query shows a generating state in the answer area and loading state in the source list.
Citation markers in the answer scroll or focus the matching source card.
Selecting a source card updates the source detail panel without losing the answer context.
Unavailable sources show a reason and a retry or request-access path.
Low-confidence answers show a caution state and suggest checking sources before sharing.
Save and share controls show working, success, and failed feedback without changing the selected strategy.
responsive_accessibility: Desktop >= 1024px uses a top search area, main answer-and-citations area, and right source detail panel.
Tablet 768-1023px collapses source detail into an expandable panel below the source list.
Mobile <= 767px orders content as search, answer status, answer body, sources, source detail, then save/share actions.
The first screen must answer: what did the user ask, how trustworthy is the answer, and where does the answer come from.
No horizontal scrolling on mobile; source cards, citation markers, and save/share controls must wrap cleanly.
Keyboard order follows search input, submit, answer citations, source cards, source detail actions, save/share controls.
Every interactive element has visible focus and at least a 44px mobile touch target.
Use semantic headings and descriptive labels for confidence, source status, and permission-blocked states.

differentiators: query, confidence, answer, and source origin visible together
source detail panel with unavailable and permission-blocked states
clear save/share workflow for useful answers

strategy_options.name: Dense Research Workspace
strategy_options.best_use_case: Best when analysts need to inspect a sourced AI answer quickly.
strategy_options.information_structure_focus: Search input, answer status, answer body, source list, and source detail panel all visible on desktop.
strategy_options.risk: Can feel too busy if hierarchy is weak.

strategy_options.name: Evidence-First Answer Detail
strategy_options.best_use_case: Best when the product must prove trust and citation quality before speed.
strategy_options.visual_tone: Source-forward, slightly more editorial, with evidence confidence in the first screen.
strategy_options.information_structure_focus: Show answer provenance before secondary actions.
strategy_options.risk: May make the answer feel less fast or less conversational.

strategy_options.name: Lightweight Team Notebook
strategy_options.best_use_case: Best when the page should feel like a saved research artifact for teams.
strategy_options.information_structure_focus: Saved answer, notes, share action, and source detail.
strategy_options.risk: May underplay the live search interaction.

reference_direction.name: Enterprise data workspace
reference_direction.source_boundary: Use data density, source hierarchy, permission states, and repeated-use ergonomics as mechanisms; do not copy third-party brand assets or full DESIGN.md files.

token_summary: Deep ink text and light neutral workspace surfaces.
Restrained blue accent for active links, citations, focus, and primary action.
Muted green for verified states and amber for low-confidence states.
8px default radius, subtle borders, and minimal shadow.
assumptions: No real product screenshot or source dataset was provided.
Use realistic placeholder source metadata without inventing customer details.

review_criteria: first screen shows query, trust, and source origin
answer and sources have clear hierarchy
mobile order keeps answer and source context intact

assumptions: The app user is already signed in.
The product has permission-aware source access.
The answer may be generated from multiple internal sources.
open_questions: Which source systems are real at launch?
How should permission requests be routed inside the product?
